cutoffs.ETF: Existing archived actual_return_from; not claimed to be exact legal listing date

common_eligibility: Matched four cells in each group use identical eligibility: 63 common post-cutoff valid one-session returns. Legacy hold-only cells preserve the old calendar-date gate without new 63-day gate to isolate the bridge.
cash: GS equal: available_count/requested_count; reference: sum original full-proxy ERC weights of eligible assets. V12 preserves original BASE weights of eligible assets without renormalizing and its original covariance/12% scale/5% buffer.
risk: GS eligible ERC estimated only on jointly valid eligible dates; proxy uses original full-basket ERC then normalizes selected weights. Reference cash deliberately retains proxy information and is not a fully isolated arm.

macro_lag.implementation: Reindex complete macro panel to GS return trading calendar, shift every column one row, discard empty first row, no backfill and no state recomputation; usual known=previous session remains.
macro_lag.scope: Single conservative information-delay sensitivity, not a verified vintage repair or uniquely correct announcement policy

engine: Same existing economic_masked amount ledger for all accounts, prior-close known inputs, next-close amount fills, fractional units, original fees and next-session sell-cash constraint; not actual opening fills.
target_cache: Target computations depend only on case/start/known date and fixed inputs, not capital or NAV. Cache separately by case+start for reuse across 9/20bp; execution/affordability/fees are recomputed in each account. Never reuse cache across altered inputs.
run_order: All 9bp main cases and 9bp cold starts, then 20bp; persist every account immediately.
validation: Known strictly before date and identical calendar within paired account windows
Cash nonnegative; weights sum1; previous NAV+P&L-cost=NAV
Independent metrics from daily ledgers to be checked separately
Reuse existing strict source perturbation tests; new lag sidecar exposes full-source date shift
failure_policy: Preserve all exceptions and partial outputs; no input invention or winner selection; missing evidence remains unresolved.
unresolved: Original macro first-release and revision vintages
Executable opening depth and actual costs
interpretation: This measures fixed historical channel and budget effects, not total P0 bias, causal alpha, future performance, or full original-vintage reconstruction.
